title: Architecture
description: A Next.js app, a worker that alone holds the NEAR keys, Postgres, and NEAR underneath, in one pnpm workspace.
icon: Server
---

<Diagram name="system" alt="Tegata's parts: the owner and the customer use the web app; the web app keeps the books in Postgres and hands jobs to the worker, the only holder of operator keys, which relays signed actions to NEAR and reads USDC events; at the edge, NEAR Intents (20 routes on 11 chains, in and out, Live), Noah (Sandbox: banks in Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, a euro IBAN), Bitnob (opening soon: virtual Visa cards) and Transak (opening soon: pay by card)" caption="The system: NEAR in the middle, partners at the edge." />

## The parts

| Part | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `apps/web` | Next.js 16: the landing page, sign-in, the app, the public invoice, pay and receipt pages, the app's API and the [developer API](/docs/build/developers), and `/dev` (every part of the design in every state) |
| `apps/worker` | Background jobs on pg-boss. The only process that holds Tegata's NEAR keys; the web server never does |
| `apps/docs` | These docs: Fumadocs, exported to static files |
| Postgres 17 | The books: users, businesses, accounts on each network, requests, payments, receipts, invoices, customers, referrals, people, payroll runs, autopilot plans, relays, payouts to other chains, bank payouts, bank accounts and deposits, cards and their purchases, API keys, events and webhook deliveries, the email outbox, wallet sign-in requests |

## The worker's jobs

| Job | When |
| --- | --- |
| `relay-send` | Each signed action: send it to NEAR, exactly once. A Tegata-balance payment, a payroll batch, a bank withdrawal and a card fill settle here |
| `account-setup` | A new sign-up: create the NEAR account and register it on USDC |
| `payment-verify` | A NEAR-wallet payment: read it from NEAR and settle it |
| `test-dollars` | A Sandbox grant: send 5 test USDC |
| `invoice-email` | An invoice or reminder email |
| `invoice-repeat` | Every 10 minutes: issue repeat invoices that are due |
| `invoice-reminder-sweep` | Every hour (at :05): queue the reminder steps that are due, including for invoices sent while email was off |
| `referral-sweep` | Every 5 minutes, and once at start: qualify invites, pay rewards past their hold |
| `destination-register` | A person's NEAR account that can't hold USDC yet: Tegata's operator registers it |
| `payment-email`, `payroll-email` | The emails a payment or a payroll run sends |
| `autopilot-register` | A business turning on autopilot: Tegata's operator pays its storage on the contract |
| `autopilot-keeper` | Every minute: call `run` on the contract for each plan whose payday has come, then record the run from its events |
| `webhook-deliver` | One signed webhook to one endpoint; a non-2xx is retried after 30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 1 h and 6 h |
| `webhook-sweep` | Every minute: queue any delivery whose retry is due |
| `oneclick-poll`, `oneclick-sweep` | A Live payment from another chain: read NEAR Intents every 5 s until it's paid, refunded, failed or expired; the sweep (every minute) picks up any left open |
| `payout-poll`, `payout-sweep` | A send, refund or payroll row to another chain: follow it until it's delivered or back |
| `bank-hop`, `bank-poll`, `bank-sweep` | A bank withdrawal: hand the USDC to Noah through the Solana hop, then check Noah every 8 s; every minute, credit bank deposits |
| `card-fund`, `card-remove`, `card-sweep` | A spend card: have Bitnob issue, raise or lower it once its money has moved on NEAR |
| `card-pay-poll`, `card-pay-sweep` | A card payment: follow the Transak order every 5 s, and in the Sandbox deliver the test USDC |
| `payroll-due` | Every hour: "Payroll is ready" for each payday that's due, from 08:00 in the business's time zone |
| `statement-monthly` | The 1st of each month, 08:00 UTC: last month's statement, by email |
| The email outbox | Every 3 s: send what's queued, through Resend |

At start the worker also picks up any relay or payment it left halfway.

## Built on

| Piece | What it does in Tegata | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NEAR named accounts | `name.tegata.testnet` (and `name.tegata.near` in Live) for every business, created with the owner's own key | `packages/core/src/near/accounts.ts`, `operator.ts` |
| Meta transactions (NEP-366) | The owner signs; the worker relays and pays the fee | `packages/core/src/near/delegate.ts`, `packages/services/src/relays.ts` |
| USDC on NEAR (NEP-141) | Every balance and settlement; "paid" is read from its transfer event | `packages/core/src/near/usdc.ts`, `transfers.ts` |
| NEAR Intents (1Click) | Live prices; in Live, payments from other chains, sends, refunds and payroll rows to them | `apps/web/lib/server/oneclick.ts`, `packages/services/src/oneclick-payments.ts`, `payouts.ts`, `packages/core/src/oneclick` |
| Noah | Bank payouts in Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa, and euro bank details (Sandbox) | `packages/core/src/noah`, `packages/services/src/bank.ts` |
| Solana | The Sandbox hop that hands Noah its test USDC | `packages/core/src/solana` |
| Bitnob | Virtual Visa spend cards and their purchases (waits on keys) | `packages/core/src/bitnob`, `packages/services/src/issued-cards.ts` |
| Transak | Pay by card, delivering USDC on NEAR (waits on keys) | `packages/core/src/transak`, `packages/services/src/card-payments.ts` |
| Gnosis | Reading a linked Gnosis Pay card's balance | `packages/core/src/gnosis` |
| NEAR Connect | Customers pay from their own NEAR wallet; owners can sign in with one (NEP-413) and approve actions as delegate actions it signs | `apps/web/lib/client/near-wallet.ts`, `near-account.ts` |
| Privy | Email sign-in that gives each owner a NEAR key | `apps/web/app/providers.tsx` |
| NEP-413 | Signing in with a NEAR wallet: a signed message with a one-time nonce, checked against the account's full-access keys | `packages/core/src/near/wallet.ts`, `packages/services/src/wallet-auth.ts` |
| react-pdf, react-email, Resend | The invoice and statement PDFs, and every email | `packages/documents` |
| Standard Webhooks | Signing every webhook, so a shop can verify it in one call | `packages/services/src/developers.ts` |

## The workspace

```
apps/web            Next.js: landing, sign-in, the app, public pages, API, /dev
apps/worker         background jobs; the only process that holds operator keys
apps/docs           these docs
packages/config     constants: networks, gas, limits, referral rules
packages/core       money, invoice and payroll maths, schedules, the people CSV; NEAR: accounts, USDC, delegate actions, the operator;
                    clients for 1Click, Noah, Solana, Bitnob, Transak and Gnosis
packages/db         Postgres schema and migrations (Drizzle)
packages/documents  the invoice and statement PDFs, and every email
packages/env        the only reader of server environment variables
packages/jobs       queue definitions
packages/services   database-aware logic shared by the web app and the worker
```

USDC contracts: `3e2210e1184b45b64c8a434c0a7e7b23cc04ea7eb7a6c3c32520d03d4afcb8af` on testnet,
`17208628f84f5d6ad33f0da3bbbeb27ffcb398eac501a31bd6ad2011e36133a1` on mainnet.
